digest.component_or_area: plan-review signing / manifest plan-material pin emission
propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit one deterministic signed pin per direct child and per direct prerequisite, using canonical ticket IDs and the target's 16-hex material fingerprint.
Pins are encoded as manifest lines sorted by role then canonical ID, with duplicate edges collapsing within a role and malformed pin variants raising ManifestFormatError.
PlanRelationSnapshot builds a store-wide preload including archived tickets to discover inbound block sources that find_inbound_relationships would omit, carrying fingerprints in related_material.

Unreadable or unresolvable targets raise PlanRelationSnapshotError with one of six exact reasons and return unsigned INDETERMINATE remediation before any LLM call, without partial pins or traceback fallback.
tracker_head_sha captures the clean tickets-tracker 40-hex HEAD after ensure_fresh, mapping dirty/unmerged/subprocess/IO/path/malformed failures to store-read-failure.

Pin collection is wired unconditionally into ordinary sign, drift refresh, and re-sign paths, while legacy pinless manifests remain authenticable and additive pin lines are ignored for field interpretation.
